title: Secret-Stego Dissimilarity as a Design Axis: Invertible Coverless Image Steganography with Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.13597v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coverless image steganography (CIS) synthesizes a stego image rather than modifying an existing cover image, enabling authorized recipients to reconstruct the original secret image from the stego. Existing diffusion-based CIS methods can generate natural-looking stego images but preserve substantial visual similarity to the secret image. This resemblance risks exposing structural and semantic cues, giving rise to security vulnerabilities that cannot be evaluated solely via recovery fidelity. Achieving substantial visual dissimilarity between the secret and stego images without compromising stego quality and recovery fidelity remains challenging. To address this issue, we propose InvCISD, an invertible diffusion framework that couples the latent representations of the secret and an irrelevant reference image with an invertible network called LIMNet. translated_title: 秘密-隐写差异作为设计轴：基于扩散模型的可逆无载体图像隐写
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13597v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：无载体图像隐写（CIS）通过合成隐写图像而非修改现有载体图像，使授权接收者能从隐写图像中重构原始秘密图像。现有的基于扩散模型的CIS方法能生成外观自然的隐写图像，但保留了与秘密图像显著的视觉相似性。这种相似性可能暴露结构和语义线索，导致仅凭恢复保真度无法评估的安全漏洞。在保持隐写质量和恢复保真度的前提下，实现秘密与隐写图像之间的显著视觉差异仍具挑战性。为解决此问题，我们提出InvCISD，一种可逆扩散框架，通过可逆网络LIMNet耦合秘密图像与无关参考图像的潜在表示。我们首先在扩散潜在空间中训练LIMNet，随后进行端到端微调。
tldr: 本文提出InvCISD，一种利用可逆网络LIMNet在扩散潜在空间中耦合秘密与无关参考图像，实现隐写图像与秘密图像视觉上显著不同且不牺牲恢复质量的可逆无载体图像隐写方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes InvCISD, an invertible diffusion framework that couples secret and irrelevant reference image latents via LIMNet, achieving substantial visual dissimilarity between stego and secret images without compromising recovery fidelity.
